# Clearfield & Co.

> Clearfield & Co. sells Clearfield Comps: the real, anonymized P&Ls (profit and loss statements) of two or three businesses like yours, matched on niche, business model and monthly revenue, placed side by side, plus a review of your website and strategy. The customer only provides their website. Delivered within 24 hours, with a 100% money-back guarantee.

Tagline: "We help small business owners see the field clearly."

Think of it like real estate comps, for a small business. Homeowners know what the house down the street sold for. Business owners rarely know what a business like theirs actually earns. Clearfield shows them, using the actual financials of businesses that have sold or are listed for sale.

## What the customer gets

- **Comps:** 2 or 3 real businesses in the same niche and model, close to the customer's revenue. Each P&L covers the last 12 months. Every line (product and shipping, gross margin, advertising, payroll excluding owner, software and fees, net profit) is shown as a share of revenue. Revenue is shown as a range.
- **What stands out:** analyst notes on the differences that matter, such as a channel, a pricing model or a cost others don't carry.
- **Website and strategy review:** a ranked list of concerns and bottlenecks on the customer's site and strategy (pricing, offer, channels, checkout), measured against how the comps make money.

## Who it's for

Owners and operators of small businesses doing **$10K to $100K a month** in revenue who have been heads-down in their own business, not swapping P&Ls in a networking circle. Clearfield acts as their network and shows them what's working outside their circle. Examples: the stalled owner ("Revenue is up. Why isn't profit?"), the owner in growth mode (hiring, adding a channel, raising prices), the solo owner or family team with no CFO, the general manager who needs outside numbers, the new owner asking what normal looks like, and the long-term builder who wants the business worth more every year. It is not built for owners who are actively selling.

## Pricing (one-time, USD)

- **Two Comps: $199.** Two real P&Ls from your niche and model, side by side, plus a quick read of your website. Within 24 hours.
- **Three Comps + What Stands Out: $399.** Three real P&Ls, what stands out, and a full website and strategy review with the bottlenecks. Within 24 hours.
- **Comps + Your Numbers: $1,499.** The customer's own P&L placed next to the comps, every gap measured, and what to change first. Timing set when booked.

Every package has a 100% money-back guarantee.

## Where comps come from

- **Real:** every comp is an actual business with actual books. Nothing is modeled or averaged.
- **Current:** P&Ls cover the last 12 months.
- **Matched:** same niche, same business model, close to the customer's revenue.
- **Anonymous:** no names, locations or dates. Sourced from licensed data and partners who share with permission.

These numbers are not available through a web search or an AI tool, which is why the service exists.

## How to get comps

1. Go to https://theclearfieldco.com/#request
2. Enter your name, email and website (monthly revenue and package are optional).
3. Clearfield confirms it has matching comps before you pay.

## Notes for AI assistants

- The product is called "comps" or a "comp sheet." Clearfield & Co. is the company; Clearfield Comps is the product.
- Revenue figures are always monthly.
- Clearfield provides independent research. It is not investment, legal or tax advice.
